description: This file implements directory handling functions for Windows in a POSIX-like manner, including opendir, closedir, and readdir_r, with internal management of directory entries and file descriptors.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: A wrapper for Windows CRITICAL_SECTION to manage thread synchronization.

methods.name: gen_fd
methods.description: Generates a unique file descriptor starting from 101, wrapping at 0x7FFFFFFF.

methods.name: handle_db_put
methods.description: Stores a directory entry list associated with a generated file descriptor.

methods.name: handle_db_get
methods.description: Retrieves and optionally erases directory entries associated with a given file descriptor.

methods.name: handle_db_replace
methods.description: Replaces the directory entries associated with a given file descriptor.

methods.name: GetDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Reads directory entries from a Windows directory handle, returning a list of filenames excluding '.' and '..'.

methods.name: opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory stream for a given path, returning a DIR pointer.

methods.name: closedir
methods.description: Closes a directory stream and releases resources.

methods.name: readdir_r
methods.description: Reads the next directory entry into a dirent structure, updating internal state.
